detected_phase1_ambiguity.issue: The frozen model-bundle schema requires bundleHash inside the manifest, but does not define how bundleHash is treated when computing the hash of that same manifest.
detected_phase1_ambiguity.risk: Naively hashing the final manifest creates a self-reference and cannot produce a stable fixed commitment.

integration_resolution.final_manifest_rule: After computing modelBundleHash, write that value into bundleHash for the human-readable/final manifest.
integration_resolution.name: ZERO_BUNDLE_HASH_PREIMAGE_V1
integration_resolution.preimage_rule: Construct the complete Phase-1-compatible manifest with bundleHash set to 0x followed by 64 zero hex characters.
integration_resolution.reason: Removes self-reference while keeping bundleHash visible inside the final off-chain manifest.
integration_resolution.verification_rule: A verifier MUST replace bundleHash with zero bytes32, RFC8785-canonicalize the manifest, then recompute keccak256.

obsolete_model_bundle_hashes.reason: Used SHA-256 instead of the Phase-1 keccak256 contract commitment policy.
Outer JCS+keccak was corrected, but the manifest itself does not conform to the frozen Phase-1 model-bundle schema; child artifact digests and required fields are incomplete.

runtime_digest_resolution.claim_limit: This is an MVP runtime-environment commitment, not proof that inference executed inside an OCI container.
runtime_digest_resolution.rule: For the hackathon MVP, runtime.containerDigest will commit to the canonical FINAL_AI_RUNTIME_MANIFEST rather than claim an OCI/container-image digest.
